purpose: Teach: デルタ/ウーマン/典範/陸自/朝鮮総連/全曲/平凡社/魅惑

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、デルタ地帯での密漁を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police will be handling the poaching case in the delta area, then.
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal tone. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Quiet observation delivered as gentle confirmation, not question. Steady cadence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ワンダーウーマン的女性活動家への支援もされますね
lines.en: Yes, and the department is also providing support to the activist involved.
lines.style: Professional but personable. Clear enunciation. Even tone that conveys competence without rigidity. A slight warmth underneath the official register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、皇室典範違反絡みの事案を、警察、慎重に扱われますね
lines.en: So the police are handling this matter carefully given the imperial law implications, I take it.
lines.style: Deliberate speech. Respectful weight on the formal elements. Slightly slower pace acknowledging the delicate nature. Gentle interrogative inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、陸自と災害時連携もされますね
lines.en: Yes. The department also coordinates with the Self-Defense Forces during disaster response situations.
lines.style: Straightforward delivery. Confident in the facts being stated. Professional composure. Slight nod in the voice—collaborative rather than defensive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、朝鮮総連系の関連事案を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police are handling the related cases involving the General Association of Korean Residents.
lines.style: Formal, observant tone. Carefully neutral phrasing. Steady rhythm without inflection that might suggest bias. Respectful acknowledgment of complexity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の声のヴォーカル全曲一致解析もされますね
lines.en: Yes. The department also conducts vocal analysis—comparing the suspect's voice across all recordings for consistency.
lines.style: Technical precision in delivery. Clear, methodical. Professional pride in forensic thoroughness. Not distant, but matter-of-fact about capability.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、平凡社の出版物に絡む盗作を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police are handling the plagiarism case involving Heibonsha publications.
lines.style: Steady, observant. Formal register maintained. Slight emphasis on the publisher name. Thoughtful pause quality as if noting specificity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、魅惑香水での誘惑詐欺事案も担当されますね
lines.en: Yes. The department is also handling the fraud cases involving alluring fragrances used to manipulate victims.
lines.style: Even, professional tone. Slight weariness under the surface—acknowledging human vulnerability without judgment. Clear articulation of the scheme type.
